d: right_id_from_left is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.r.short: For a commutative operation, a left identity is also a right identity

d: right_absorb_from_left is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.r.short: For a commutative operation, a left-absorbing element is also right-absorbing

d: right_inverse_from_left is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.r.short: For a commutative operation, left inverses with a given unit are also right inverses
If a commutative f distributes over g on the left, it also distributes on the right

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.l.short: If a commutative f distributes over g on the right, it also distributes on the left

d: involutive_alt is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.i.short: The law of an involution in pointwise form: f(f x) = x

d: idempotent_alt is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.i.short: The law of an idempotent function in pointwise form: f(f x) = f x

d: involutive_bijective is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.i.short: An involution is bijective, with itself as its inverse

d: left_or_right_absorb is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.l.short: If z absorbs f on both sides, then x = z or y = z implies f(x, y) = z

d: absorb_ne_left_and_right is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.a.short: If z absorbs f on both sides, f(x, y) ≠ z implies x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z

d: left_par_right_absorb is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.l.short: With refutative equality and z absorbing f on both sides, x = z ⊞ y = z implies f(x, y) = z

d: absorb_ne_left_prod_right is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.a.short: With refutative equality and z absorbing f on both sides, f(x, y) ≠ z implies x ≠ z ⊠ y ≠ z

d: left_cancellation is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.l.short: Left cancellation: if f(x, −) is injective, then y₁ = y₂ if and only if f(x, y₁) = f(x, y₂)

d: right_cancellation is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.r.short: Right cancellation: if f(−, y) is injective, x₁ = x₂ ⧟ f(x₁, y) = f(x₂, y)

d: right_cancel_from_left is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.r.short: For a commutative operation, injectivity in every left slot gives injectivity in every right slot

d: Associative_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.A.short: The opposite of an associative operation is associative

d: Commutative_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.C.short: The opposite of a commutative operation is commutative

d: BinaryIdempotent_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.B.short: The opposite of an idempotent binary operation is idempotent

d: RightIdentity_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.R.short: A left identity of f is a right identity of the opposite operation

d: LeftIdentity_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.L.short: A right identity of f is a left identity of the opposite operation

d: RightAbsorb_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.R.short: A left-absorbing element of f is right-absorbing for the opposite operation

d: LeftAbsorb_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.L.short: A right-absorbing element of f is left-absorbing for the opposite operation

d: RightInverse_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.R.short: Left inverses for f are right inverses for the opposite operation

d: LeftInverse_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.L.short: Right inverses for f are left inverses for the opposite operation

d: RightDistribute_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.R.short: If f distributes over g on the left, the opposite of f distributes over g on the right

d: LeftDistribute_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.L.short: If f distributes over g on the right, the opposite of f distributes over g on the left

d: Distribute_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.D.short: If a unary f distributes over g, it also distributes over the opposite of g

d: AntiDistribute_op is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.A.short: If f anti-distributes over g, it also anti-distributes over the opposite of g

AffineConstructive.theory.common_props.g.short: Proves an algebraic law of f ∘ tensor_swap from the corresponding law H of f, with arguments swapped
